Game Guide & Lore

About the Game

Dungeon Outcast is a free-to-play browser-based dungeon crawler game inspired by Tango Tek's "Decked Out 2" minigame from Hermitcraft Season 9. Navigate through dark, treacherous dungeons, avoid deadly monsters, collect valuable artifacts, and escape before your haze meter attracts too many enemies!

This 2D adaptation brings the thrilling stealth-action gameplay to your browser with no downloads required.

How to Play – Game Controls

Master these controls to survive the dungeon:

  • WASD / Arrow Keys – Move your character through the dungeon
  • SHIFT (Hold) – Sneak mode for silent movement (reduces haze)
  • SPACEBAR – Jump over obstacles and gaps
  • F Key – Harvest berries from bushes or eat from inventory
  • E Key – Search for artifacts at marked locations

Game Features

  • 🏃 Stealth Gameplay – Your movements create "haze" that attracts enemies
  • 👹 Dangerous Enemies – Frost Beasts patrol corridors, Specters shoot fireballs, and Phantoms spawn when haze is high
  • 🔥 Ember Collection – Gather embers scattered throughout the dungeon for points
  • 🍒 Survival Mechanics – Find and eat berries to restore health
  • 🧭 Compass Navigation – Follow your compass to locate artifacts and exits
  • 👑 Rare Artifacts – Discover unique treasures with different values
  • 📱 Mobile Friendly – Touch controls available for mobile devices

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Dungeon Outcast free to play?

Yes! Dungeon Outcast is completely free to play in your browser with no downloads or accounts required.

Does the game work on mobile?

Yes, enable "Touch Controls" on the start screen to play on smartphones and tablets.

What is "haze" in the game?

Haze is a detection meter that increases when you run, jump, or move quickly. High haze attracts dangerous Phantom enemies, so sneak to stay safe!

How do I win the game?

Find the hidden artifact by pressing E at marked locations, then escape through the exit before the monsters get you!
